items.titleEn: Schlittler, Cease pitch during same series amid Cy Young Award race
bodyEn: TORONTO -- It’s a Cy Young showdown this weekend at Rogers Centre, Dylan Cease versus Cam Schlittler with each of their lineups trying to tear the other guy down.

The AL Cy Young Award has become a two-horse race, and if the season ended today, it’s nothing near unanimous. Schlittler is scheduled to pitch Saturday with Cease throwing in the finale on Sunday, which lines each of them up to pitch in next week’s series (Aug. 21-23) at Yankee Stadium, too.
This is where the race stands and what’s at stake over the next week:
MAKE YOUR CASE:
Cam Schlittler, New York Yankees• 10-6, 2.21 ERA (146.2 IP)• 4.7 WAR (FanGraphs)

The 25-year-old sensation has owned this conversation through the heart of the season, carrying a sub-two ERA into late June. This race is all about the inches, the slight advantages that add up to someone winning by a few votes. Schlittler, at first glance, has the stronger ERA and he’s done it over more innings after Cease spent two weeks on the IL with a hamstring strain.
Schlittler’s strikeout rate (11.2 K/9) is elite for a starter, and while it’s not quite at Cease’s level (13.1), he’s done this with a walk rate that is essentially half of Cease’s.

Remember, this award is voted on by 30 members of the BBWAA (Baseball Writers' Association of America) each year. Just like the MVP Award, voters value certain metrics over others, while team success can also bleed into the context. If Schlittler’s Yankees stay hot down the stretch and Cease’s Blue Jays fade, could that shift in the conversation further benefit Schlittler? Besides, he has the numbers to back up his case and is one of baseball’s most entertaining pitchers to watch.
Dylan Cease, Toronto Blue Jays• 7-5, 2.40 ERA (131 1/3 IP)• 4.5 WAR
Cease’s case, here and now, leans more on advanced metrics and overwhelming strikeout numbers. Those are fine arguments, too.

Even after missing a couple of starts, Cease leads the American League in strikeouts (191). Across the Majors, he trails only the strikeout king himself, Jacob Misiorowski (204). Again, we’re talking about small margins here, but Cease’s ceiling has been a few inches higher than Schlittler’s, but Schlittler has a sturdier floor.

So many of their surface-level stats are too close to call, coming down to a matter of style or preference more than anything else. Some of the advanced metrics, like FIP, favor Cease slightly, and if we’d like to get really fine with this argument, Cease has allowed a lower average exit velocity and fewer home runs (14 to nine).
The more we dig, though, the more we see how close these pitchers are, neither of them with one truly undeniable number that overshadows the rest.
SOME HELP FROM THEIR FRIENDS?

Schlittler has handled the Blue Jays just fine this season, allowing just three runs over his 13 innings with 14 strikeouts. The Blue Jays were much tougher on Schlittler a year ago as a rookie, including a start in early September when they chased him after just 1 2/3 innings, but we haven’t seen that version of the Blue Jays much this season.

Cease has faced the Yankees just once in 2026, allowing two runs over four innings of work. With four walks and nine strikeouts, that was a classic Cease outing, flashing dominant stuff but not nearly efficient enough. That’s the blueprint to beating Cease, and while we’re only working with a one-day sample size here, the Yankees have at least pulled it off.
Still, the margins are so tight. If one lineup can hang five runs on the opposing starter and flip the ERA race here, that could go a long way.
TEAM HISTORY
Wouldn’t you have guessed the Yankees had a bigger edge than six Cy Young Awards to the Blue Jays’ five? They’re connected by Roger Clemens, too, who won with each organization.
The Yankees have 25 MVP Awards in their franchise’s deep history, and you may have heard they’ve won the World Series 27 times, but the Cy Young has been more elusive.
Yankees: Gerrit Cole (2003), Roger Clemens (2001), Ron Guidry (1978), Sparkly Lyle (1977), Whitey Ford (1961), Bob Turley (1958)
Blue Jays: Robbie Ray (2021), Roy Halladay (2003), Roger Clemens (1997-’98), Pat Hentgen (1996)
items.titleZh: 赛扬奖竞争白热化，Schlittler与Cease系列赛同场对决
items.summaryZh: 赛扬奖之争进入白热化，Cease与Schlittler本周末同场对决，下周再战。
bodyZh: 多伦多 -- 本周末罗杰斯中心将上演一场赛扬奖对决，Dylan Cease对阵Cam Schlittler，双方打线都试图击垮对方。
美国联盟赛扬奖已成为两人之争，如果今天赛季结束，结果远非一致。Schlittler计划于周六先发，Cease则在周日收官战中登板，这也让两人有望在下周（8月21-23日）于洋基球场的系列赛中再次对决。
以下是目前竞争形势以及未来一周的关键所在：
各自战绩：
Cam Schlittler，纽约洋基· 10胜6负，自责分率2.21（146.2局）· 胜利贡献值4.7（FanGraphs）
这位25岁的超级新星在赛季中期一直主导着这一话题，直到6月底仍保持低于2的自责分率。这场竞争比拼的是细节，微小的优势累积起来，最终可能以几票之差决出胜负。Schlittler乍一看拥有更出色的自责分率，而且他在更多的局数中做到了这一点，因为Cease曾因腿筋拉伤在伤病名单中待了两周。
Schlittler的三振率（每九局11.2次）在先发投手中属于顶级，虽然还不及Cease的水平（13.1），但他的保送率几乎只有Cease的一半。
请记住，该奖项每年由美国棒球作家协会（BBWAA）的30名成员投票选出。与MVP奖一样，投票者会看重某些数据，而球队的成功也会影响评选。如果Schlittler的洋基队在赛季末段保持火热，而Cease的蓝鸟队状态下滑，这种形势的转变是否会进一步有利于Schlittler？此外，他有数据支撑自己的论点，并且是棒球界最具观赏性的投手之一。
Dylan Cease，多伦多蓝鸟· 7胜5负，自责分率2.40（131又1/3局）· 胜利贡献值4.5
Cease目前的优势更多体现在进阶数据和惊人的三振数上。这些都是有力的论据。
即使缺席了几场先发，Cease仍以191次三振领跑美国联盟。在整个大联盟中，他只落后于三振王Jacob Misiorowski（204次）。再说一次，我们谈论的是微小差距，但Cease的上限比Schlittler略高，而Schlittler的下限更稳固。
他们的许多基础数据太过接近，难以判断，更多是风格或偏好的问题。一些进阶数据，如FIP，略微偏向Cease，如果我们想更细致地比较，Cease的平均出口速度更低，被本垒打也更少（14比9）。
然而，越深入分析，越能看出这两位投手的接近程度，他们都没有一项真正无可争议的数据能够压倒其他方面。
来自队友的助力？
Schlittler本赛季对阵蓝鸟队表现出色，13局仅失3分，送出14次三振。去年作为新秀时，蓝鸟队曾给Schlittler制造了不少麻烦，包括9月初的一次先发，仅让他投了1又2/3局就被打退，但本赛季我们很少看到那样的蓝鸟队。
2026年Cease仅面对过洋基队一次，四局失两分。四次保送和九次三振，这是典型的Cease式比赛，展现出了统治力，但效率不够高。这就是击败Cease的蓝图，虽然我们这里只有一天的样本，但洋基队至少做到了。
尽管如此，差距仍然非常微小。如果某一方打线能对对方先发投手拿下五分，从而扭转自责分率的竞争，那将大有帮助。
球队历史
你是不是以为洋基队会比蓝鸟队有更大的优势？洋基队获得过六次赛扬奖，蓝鸟队五次。两队还因Roger Clemens而联系在一起，他曾效力于两支球队并都赢得了赛扬奖。
洋基队在其悠久的历史中拥有25座MVP奖杯，你可能听说过他们27次赢得世界大赛，但赛扬奖却更难企及。
洋基队：Gerrit Cole（2003）、Roger Clemens（2001）、Ron Guidry（1978）、Sparkly Lyle（1977）、Whitey Ford（1961）、Bob Turley（1958）
蓝鸟队：Robbie Ray（2021）、Roy Halladay（2003）、Roger Clemens（1997-'98）、Pat Hentgen（1996）

items.titleEn: Blue Jays surging up Wild Card standings -- but holding breath over Vladdy
bodyEn: TORONTO -- Things are getting awfully interesting north of the border.

The Blue Jays, who spent much of this season growing stale on the outer edges of the postseason picture, suddenly have as much momentum as any team in the American League Wild Card race. Friday night’s 3-1 win over the Yankees puts Toronto (60-64) just one game back of the final postseason spot with 38 games remaining.
This is what mattered most:

1. Holding their breath: Guerrero injuredVladimir Guerrero Jr. left the game soon after scoring the Blue Jays’ first run in the sixth, a messy play during which he collided with George Lombard Jr. at third base before scoring on the error.

Even with a .693 OPS next to his name, Guerrero is still the player the Blue Jays can least afford to lose because of the upside he still represents. We’re also just three days away from the one-year anniversary of the last time Guerrero hit a regular-season home run at Rogers Centre.

Everyone has a theory, because of course they do. The Blue Jays are stuck on the doorstep of the AL Wild Card race, but if Guerrero were playing anything like he’s capable of, they’d already be sitting comfortably in one of those spots. What else do you expect people to talk about?

“People are always trying to have the right answer,” manager John Schneider said. “All of the things that are out there, some of them are probably close to being right and some of them probably aren’t. There are a lot of theories out there. I think the person who knows his swing the best is Vlad.”

2. Madness on the bases!The Blue Jays have made a habit of staring their opponents down this week and not blinking first. The Red Sox made a handful of crucial errors that flipped games in that four-game series, and Friday night, it was the Yankees’ turn. If the Blue Jays’ offense is going to leave them stuck in low-scoring games, this is the type of airtight baseball they need to be playing.

What looked like an inning-ending double play off the bat of George Springer quickly went wild when the throw to first skipped in front of Luis García Jr., who couldn’t make the scoop. That sent Guerrero racing from second to third -- the play during which he was injured -- and eventually scampering home.

By the time Alejandro Kirk doubled in the go-ahead run, that felt like a footnote on the inning. This feels like the blueprint for the Blue Jays, finding any way to win, regardless of whether it’s beautiful or not.

3. Bieber and the Blue Jays look refreshedFor weeks leading up to the Trade Deadline, Shane Bieber was an obvious trade candidate, given that he was a pending free agent on a disappointing team. The Blue Jays chose to hold onto Bieber, though, and even though he was coming off a rough outing against the Phillies on Sunday, this looked like Bieber at his best with six innings of one-run ball.
Good pitching, clean defense and a scrappy run at the right time. If the Blue Jays can find an identity coming out of their busy Trade Deadline, this is it.

“I felt like we were a little bit stagnant, kind of waiting for someone to do something,” Schneider said. “I do think that it’s removed us from 2025 a little bit, just because of the different people in the building. Every team is different. You can’t force a team to be like the team last year. With some new guys who have some things to prove, that’s rubbed off on everyone who has been here. This is the brand of baseball we’ve been searching for.”
items.titleZh: 蓝鸟外卡排名飙升 但为Vladdy捏把汗
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟胜洋基，距外卡席位仅差1场，Vladimir Guerrero Jr.受伤。
bodyZh: 多伦多——边境以北的局势正变得格外有趣。
蓝鸟队本赛季大部分时间都在季后赛版图的边缘日渐平庸，但突然间，他们在美国联盟外卡争夺战中拥有了与任何球队一样的势头。周五晚上以3-1击败纽约洋基队后，多伦多（60胜64负）仅落后最后一个季后赛席位1个胜场，还剩38场比赛。
以下是本场比赛最重要的方面：
1. 捏把汗：格雷罗受伤。Vladimir Guerrero Jr.在第六局为蓝鸟队跑回第一分后不久便退场，这是一个混乱的回合：他在三垒与George Lombard Jr.相撞，随后利用对方失误跑回本垒。
即便他目前OPS只有.693，格雷罗依然是蓝鸟队最输不起的球员，因为他仍代表着球队的上限。另外，再过三天，就是格雷罗上一次在Rogers Centre打出常规赛本垒打的一周年。
每个人都有一种说法，当然如此。蓝鸟队目前就卡在美国联盟外卡争夺战的门口，但如果格雷罗能发挥出他应有的水平，他们本可以稳稳占据其中一个席位。你还指望人们谈论什么呢？
“人们总是试图找到正确答案，”主教练John Schneider表示。“外界的各种说法，有些可能接近真相，有些则未必。理论有很多。我认为最了解他挥棒的人就是Vlad。”
2. 垒上疯狂！蓝鸟队本周已经习惯于与对手对峙，并且从不先眨眼。红袜队在那个四连战中多次出现关键失误，扭转了比赛走势，而周五晚上轮到了洋基队。如果蓝鸟队的进攻让他们陷入低比分比赛，他们就需要打出这种滴水不漏的棒球。
George Springer打出一记看似会以双杀结束半局的球，但传向一垒的球在Luis García Jr.面前弹地，他未能接住。这让格雷罗从二垒冲向三垒——正是在这次跑垒中他受了伤——并最终连跑带跳地回到本垒。
等到Alejandro Kirk打出超前分的二垒安打时，之前的一切都像这一局的注脚。这似乎就是蓝鸟队的蓝图：无论方式是否漂亮，都要想办法赢球。
3. Bieber与蓝鸟焕然一新。在交易截止日前的数周内，Shane Bieber显然是一个交易候选人，因为他是这支令人失望的球队中即将成为自由球员的球员。但蓝鸟队选择留下Bieber，尽管他在周日对阵费城人队的比赛中表现不佳，但这场比赛看起来是Bieber的最佳表现：六局仅失一分。
出色的投球、干净的防守和关键时刻的顽强进攻。如果蓝鸟队能在繁忙的交易截止日后找到自己的定位，这就是他们的定位。
“我觉得我们之前有些停滞，像是在等某个人做点什么，”Schneider表示。“我确实认为这让我们稍微脱离了2025年的轨迹，只是因为更衣室里的人不同了。每支球队都不一样。你不能强迫一支球队变成去年的样子。有些新来的人有想要证明的东西，这种心态也感染了在这里的每个人。这就是我们一直在寻找的棒球风格。”

items.titleEn: Guerrero exits, in concussion protocol after collision on chaotic play
bodyEn: TORONTO -- Vladimir Guerrero Jr. was removed from Friday night’s game against the Yankees with an apparent injury after colliding with George Lombard Jr. in a chaotic play at third base.

Guerrero actually scored on the play, but it was immediately clear that he was dealing with some discomfort. Manager John Schneider and the Blue Jays’ trainer popped out of the dugout to walk back alongside Guerrero, who was soon removed from the game and replaced by rookie Charles McAdoo.

Guerrero started the play standing on first base, but after a throw across the diamond from Ryan McMahon skipped in front of Luis García Jr., who couldn’t make the scoop, Guerrero broke for third. The throw back across the diamond to third base caught the Yankees without a man on the bag, and as Lombard tried to get there for the throw, he and Guerrero collided awkwardly.
Guerrero has been dealing with back issues throughout the 2026 season. He has also had some hamstring issues flare up, but never to the point where an IL stint has been considered.
Further updates are expected following Friday’s game.
items.titleZh: 小格雷罗在混乱冲撞后退出比赛，进入脑震荡检测程序
bodyZh: 多伦多——弗拉基米尔·格雷罗二世在周五晚对阵洋基队的比赛中，于三垒一次混乱的冲撞后因伤离场。
格雷罗在该次进攻中实际上跑回了本垒得分，但明显可以看出他有些不适。主教练约翰·施奈德和蓝鸟队的训练师走出休息区，陪同格雷罗走回，随后格雷罗被换下场，由新秀查尔斯·麦卡杜顶替。
格雷罗从一垒开始跑垒，但在瑞安·麦克马洪的传球绕过内野、路易斯·加西亚二世未能接住后，格雷罗冲向三垒。回传三垒的传球让洋基队无人守垒，隆巴德试图赶到接球时，与格雷罗发生了尴尬的碰撞。
格雷罗在整个2026赛季一直受到背部问题困扰，他也有过腿筋问题发作，但从未严重到需要进入伤病名单。
预计在周五的比赛结束后会有进一步的更新。

items.titleEn: Draft, Deadline mean shakeup atop Blue Jays' top prospects list
bodyEn: TORONTO -- To appreciate the value of the Blue Jays’ farm system, we need to step back and look at the bigger picture.

Year after year, this front office has shown a willingness to deal top prospects and first-round picks. At this Trade Deadline, it helped them land a potential frontline starter in José Soriano, which cost them a prospect package fronted by No. 2 prospect Arjun Nimmala. A year ago, the Blue Jays dealt several prospects from their top 10 to fuel a World Series run with Louis Varland, Shane Bieber and Seranthony Domínguez.

This isn’t new, either. José Berríos was brought to the Blue Jays from the Twins for a big-time package, too, headlined by Austin Martin. This farm system has improved at steadily producing big league contributors and hit the jackpot with Trey Yesavage a year ago, but Toronto’s player development staff also deserves a great deal of credit for the trade chips they’ve stacked up for their front office.
Outside of the Soriano deal, though, this Deadline was more about selling than buying, which brings some fresh talent back in the other direction.
Here’s a look at where the Blue Jays’ farm system stands after our full midseason re-rank, including all new prospects from the MLB Draft and the Trade Deadline.
Here’s a look at the Blue Jays’ top prospects:
JoJo Parker, SS (No. 26 in MLB)
Nolan Perry, RHP (No. 96 in MLB)
Johnny King, LHP
Cole Carlon, LHP
Will Brick, C
Complete Top 30 list »
Biggest jump/fall
Here are the players whose ranks changed the most from the preseason list:
Jump: Danny Thompson Jr. (Preseason: NR | Midseason: 16)

An eighth-round pick from the 2025 Draft, Thompson is looking like one of this system’s better development stories, and at 24, he’s putting himself in a very interesting spot with a good stretch at Double-A New Hampshire. Between the two levels this season, Thompson has posted a 3.10 ERA with 112 strikeouts over 90 innings. A strong finish to this season will set Thompson up for a shot at Triple-A in 2027, bringing an opportunity to emerge as a legitimate piece of big league depth.
Fall: Silvano Hechavarria (Preseason: 14 | Midseason: NR)

After starting his season a few weeks late, Hechavarria has put up some inconsistent outings that all add up to a 7.98 ERA with only 46 strikeouts over 58 2/3 innings. Walks have been an issue, too, with 37 over that span, which is a surprising line from the young right-hander who showed a much stronger sense of control in previous seasons. Hechavarria is a big, physically gifted pitcher with real mound presence, but coming into this season, he needed to miss more bats. That clearly hasn’t happened, but he remains an interesting developmental project given his raw tools and success at the lower levels.

items.titleZh: 选秀与交易截止日令蓝鸟顶级新秀名单大洗牌
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟中期新秀榜更新，选秀和交易带来多位新面孔。
bodyZh: 多伦多——要理解蓝鸟农场系统的价值，我们需要退后一步，从更宏观的角度来看待。

年复一年，这支球队的管理层都表现出交易顶级新秀和首轮签的意愿。在本次交易截止日，他们因此得到了潜在的前段先发投手何塞·索里亚诺（José Soriano），代价是由2号新秀阿尔琼·尼玛拉（Arjun Nimmala）领衔的一批新秀。一年前，蓝鸟交易了前十新秀中的数人，换来了路易斯·瓦兰德（Louis Varland）、肖恩·比伯（Shane Bieber）和塞兰托尼·多明格斯（Seranthony Domínguez），以助推世界大赛征程。
这也并非新鲜事。何塞·贝里奥斯（José Berríos）也是从双城交易到蓝鸟的，当时同样付出了以奥斯汀·马丁（Austin Martin）为首的丰厚筹码。这套农场系统已经稳步提升了培养大联盟球员的能力，一年前还靠特雷·耶萨维奇（Trey Yesavage）押中了宝，但多伦多的球员发展团队也因他们为管理层积累的交易筹码而值得称赞。
不过，除了索里亚诺这笔交易，这个截止日更多是在出售而非引进，因此也为球队换回了一些新鲜血液。
以下是在我们进行完整的中期重新排名后，蓝鸟农场系统的状况，其中包含了来自MLB选秀和交易截止日的所有新秀。

Thompson是2025年选秀第八轮选中的球员，他看起来是这个体系中最出色的培养故事之一。现年24岁的他在2A新罕布什尔州的出色表现让自己处于一个非常有利的位置。本赛季在两个级别的比赛中，Thompson在90局中取得了3.10的自责分率，送出112次三振。如果本赛季末段表现出色，Thompson将在2027年获得前往3A的机会，从而有望成为大联盟深度阵容中的真正一员。

items.titleEn: 'We're a full send': Schneider, Blue Jays adopt all-in mentality amid Wild Card race
bodyEn: TORONTO -- There’s something dangerous about 26 ball players with nothing to lose.

Reports of the Blue Jays’ death have been greatly exaggerated. This team is alive again, breathing the oxygen of a depressed AL Wild Card race which has left the door cracked open for them. Which of these other contenders are truly undeniable? Why not the Blue Jays?

This team still needs an offensive outburst and desperately needs Vladimir Guerrero Jr., but these past two weeks have brought better days. Fresh off taking three of four from the Red Sox, the Blue Jays welcome the Yankees to town Friday night, sitting just two games behind the Rangers and Tigers for the final spot in the AL Wild Card race.
“Maybe the baseball gods are changing their minds about us,” manager John Schneider said.

The Blue Jays no longer seem content to leave their fate to the gods, though. That’s how it felt before the Trade Deadline, an organization stuck in the mud and unable to escape the long shadow of their 2025 run to Game 7 of the World Series against the Dodgers. Slowly and steadily, the season kept slipping away, each game feeling too similar to the last.

Something’s changed, though. This is part relief, with the Trade Deadline and its realities now behind the Blue Jays, and part acceptance. Sure, they’d rather be 20 games above .500 and taking another run at the division, but that’s not their current reality. The reality is that they begin a 39-game season Friday night at Rogers Centre against the Yankees, and they need to beat a handful of average AL contenders by a couple of games to make it a successful one. Why not?

“It’s been nice to feel the energy shift over the last week. Not just on the field, but in here with the guys, too,” Schneider said. “The bullpen knows we’re a full send. The lineup knows it’s the same way. We used the whole bench yesterday. We’re just going for it.”

Print the t-shirts now, “Full Send” plastered across a Blue Jays logo. If they can shock the baseball world and sneak into the postseason, you might find one of those shirts or towels draped on your seat in October.

Schneider is the right manager for this exact team in this exact spot. Grip it, rip it, send it and see what happens. If the Blue Jays take big hacks and it doesn’t work? So be it. If they try to take the extra base and get thrown out? Well, they weren’t in a postseason spot to begin with anyway. Throw punches until you hit the ground.
The veterans on this roster know how rare this is, some of them running out of opportunities to chase October. It’s addicting once you’ve tasted it.
“We’re right in this fight,” Max Scherzer said. “We’re in it. This is fun to be in this situation. Every game matters. Every start matters.”

Schneider’s job description feels so much different right now than it did a year ago. He’s batting rookies Charles McAdoo and Brett Bateman in the top two spots regularly, shuffling his lineup daily and trying to drag his struggling superstar, Guerrero, out of a career-worst slump. These are not the days for analytics and lineup optimization. Schneider needs energized, motivated ball players ready to run through a wall.

In the Blue Jays’ dugout, he’s cranked up the speakers connected to the stadium’s sound system. Most of the players didn’t even know those were in there, but suddenly, music is pumping right into the dugout at full volume, anything he can do to wrangle the energy and chaos of this building.
“I love music. It’s like the crowd. You can hear it, but if you can really hear it, that goes under that category of a ‘full send’,” Schneider said. “Like, let’s [freaking] go.”
Maybe that’s another t-shirt in a couple of months, but with a Blue Jays logo covering up a few letters.
This is all sitting right in front of the Blue Jays now. First, they need to survive the Yankees, the Rays and the Yankees once again in New York. After that, though? It’s a dream schedule.

The Blue Jays’ last 30 games, beginning Aug. 25 against the Royals, all come against teams with a record below .500, and many of them are involved in the AL Wild Card race. Every day will be moving day, especially if the Blue Jays can carry this momentum through the next 10 days against their division rivals.
Until then? Send it.
items.titleZh: 蓝鸟主帅Schneider：外卡战‘全力冲刺’
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟在美联外卡争夺中状态回升，主帅Schneider表示将‘全力冲刺’，不留退路。
bodyZh: 多伦多——当26名球员一无所有时，他们就是危险的。
关于蓝鸟队死亡的报道被大大夸大了。这支球队再次活了过来，呼吸着美联外卡争夺战的氧气。尽管竞争形势低迷，但大门仍为他们留了一道缝。这些竞争者中，有谁真正不可撼动？为什么不能是蓝鸟队？
这支球队仍然需要进攻爆发，迫切渴求 Vladimir Guerrero Jr. 找回状态，但过去两周已迎来好转。刚从四场对红袜的比赛中拿下三场，蓝鸟队将于周五晚上在主场迎战洋基队，目前在美联外卡争夺中仅落后游骑兵和老虎两个胜场，竞争最后一个席位。
“也许棒球之神正在改变对我们的看法，”主教练 John Schneider 说道。
然而，蓝鸟队似乎不再甘心听天由命。这是交易截止日前的感受：球队深陷泥沼，无法摆脱2025年世界大赛对阵道奇队抢七大战的阴影。赛季在缓慢而稳定地流失，每场比赛都感觉与前一场如出一辙。
不过，还是有所改变。这一部分是解脱，因为交易截止日及其现实已过去；一部分是接受。当然，他们更愿意胜场比负场多20场，再次向分区发起冲击，但这不是他们目前的现实。现实是，他们将从周五晚上在 Rogers Centre 对阵洋基队开始最后39场比赛，需要战胜几支普通的美联竞争者，多赢几场，才能让这个赛季取得成功。为什么不呢？
“过去一周感受到能量的变化真是太好了。不仅是在场上，更衣室里也是一样，”Schneider 说道。“牛棚知道我们要全力冲刺。打线也是一样。昨天我们启用了整个替补席。我们就是要放手一搏。”
现在就可以印制T恤了，蓝鸟队徽上印着‘全力冲刺’字样。如果他们能震惊棒球界并悄然闯入季后赛，你或许会在十月份发现自己的座位上有这样一件T恤或毛巾。
Schneider 正是这支球队在目前处境下的合适主帅。握紧球棒，用力挥击，全力冲刺，然后静观其变。如果蓝鸟队放手一搏却没成功？那就算了。如果他们试图多占一个垒包却被触杀？反正他们本来就不在季后赛席位中。挥拳出击，直至倒下。
阵容中的老将们知道这有多难得，其中有些人追逐季后赛的机会已所剩无几。一旦尝过这种滋味，就会上瘾。
“我们正处在这场战斗之中，”Max Scherzer 说道。“我们身处其中。身处这种局面很有趣。每场比赛都很关键，每次先发都很关键。”
Schneider 现在的工作职责与一年前相比感觉大不相同。他经常让新秀 Charles McAdoo 和 Brett Bateman 打前两棒，每天调整打线，并试图让还在挣扎的超级巨星 Guerrero 走出职业生涯最严重的低潮。现在不是讲究数据分析和优化打线的时候。Schneider 需要精力充沛、动力十足、准备好撞穿一堵墙的球员。
在蓝鸟队的休息区，他调高了连接球场音响系统的扬声器音量。大多数球员甚至不知道那里有扬声器，但突然间，音乐以最大音量涌入休息区，只要能驾驭这座球场的能量和混乱，他什么都愿意做。
“我喜欢音乐。它就像人群一样。你能听到它，但如果你真的听得很清楚，那就属于‘全力冲刺’的范畴了，”Schneider 说道。“就像，我们他妈的冲吧。”
也许几个月后会有另一款T恤，但蓝鸟队徽会遮住几个字母。
现在这一切都摆在蓝鸟队面前。首先，他们需要挺过洋基队、光芒队，然后再次在纽约对阵洋基队。不过之后呢？这是一个梦幻赛程。
蓝鸟队最后30场比赛，从8月25日对阵皇家队开始，对手都是胜率不足五成的球队，其中许多队也参与美联外卡争夺。每一天都将是排位变动日，尤其是如果蓝鸟队能够在接下来10天对阵分区对手时保持这股势头。
在那之前？全力冲刺。
